excerpt_rules.cap_policy: remove entire steps farthest from a lead first; later step wins distance ties; task retained
excerpt_rules.citations: validate against retained neutral indices, then map to original run step IDs
excerpt_rules.lead_mapping: original run step IDs mapped through BlindRun.origins; missing IDs fail closed
excerpt_rules.model_input: generic prompt and redacted excerpt only; no identities, leads, detectors or labels
excerpt_rules.nonagent_lead: anchor at the number of preceding agent steps
excerpt_rules.omissions: all missing neutral-index ranges explicitly marked; no partial step truncation
excerpt_rules.selection: first user/task step plus agent steps at agent-rank distance <=5 of a lead
